title: Floating pipeline log overlay
summary: Added a persistent read-only floating Pipeline Log overlay for the topbar Log button. The overlay tails /api/diagnostics log_tail, remains visible across page/tab navigation, and keeps the existing native Pipeline Log window available from Launch.
reason: The topbar Log button was intended to expose an always-visible pipeline log, but its prior bridge fell back to Diagnostics > Logs when native Tauri invocation was unavailable or failed.
behavior_before: The topbar Log button used the native Pipeline Log bridge and could navigate to Diagnostics > Logs as a fallback, making it act like a diagnostics shortcut instead of a persistent floating log.
behavior_after: The topbar Log button toggles a fixed in-app floating log overlay. The overlay refreshes diagnostics while open, keeps the last good log on stale/read failures, and does not navigate to Diagnostics or invoke Tauri. The Launch page button still opens the native Pipeline Log window.
tests_added: Expanded tests/webview/test_webview_pipeline_log_window_static.py with static assertions for floatingPipelineLog.js and a Node smoke covering topbar open, tab-switch persistence, close, and no Diagnostics navigation.

rollback_plan: Remove floatingPipelineLog.js and floating-pipeline-log.css, remove the overlay markup and script import, restore the topbar button binding in pipelineLogWindowBridge.js, and revert the inventory/test/Tauri asset-contract updates in this packet.
